findings.rationale: The aws_iam_role.admin resource carries an aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin binding that grants admin-level permissions while the role's trust policy permits arbitrary assumed roles — enabling privilege escalation from any caller.

The aws_iam_policy named assume_broadly contains a Statement that authorizes sts:AssumeAction on wildcard (*) resources, granting overly permissive cross-account or cross-service assumption capability beyond the principle of least privilege.

The aws_iam_role.external_trust defines a trust policy whose Statement[0] explicitly lists external account ARNs in its Principal field, permitting identity assertion from outside the organization into an internal role.

findings.control: identity boundary: MFA condition on sensitive trust
findings.rationale: The same external trust role's Statement[0] grants sts:AssumeRole access to external principals without attaching any Condition block enforcing multi-factor authentication, meaning the role can be assumed solely by presenting valid credentials.
